summary: PowerCompute, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing it regained compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 bid price requirement after effecting a 1-for-25 reverse stock split effective July 3, 2026. Nasdaq confirmed closing prices above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days from July 13 to July 24, 2026, closing the matter. The filing is a routine regulatory compliance update with no special-situation transaction, strategic review, or material corporate event. The reverse split was a structural remedy to maintain listing, with no shareholder premium, deal terms, or advisors involved. What to watch: continued compliance with Nasdaq listing standards and potential future capital markets activity.
